administration_notes: Natural Earth polygons describe physical land and water only. They are not 1840/1860/1890/1900/1917/1927/1940 political borders.
Historical control is scenario data attached to real city coordinates; control radii are a game influence visual and are not county boundaries.
A province-scoped mission can cite the period administration in the timeline record without painting an unsupported historic province polygon over the physical map.

terrain_classification.method: Registered EPSG:3857 GeoTIFF, bilinear interpolation, point/area registration respected; nine points over a 100 km square centered at each strategic cell
terrain_classification.precision: Broad physical relief at continental control-cell scale; not tactical local slope or period land use

notices: This is the continental strategic layer; city influence polygons are presentation zones and never overwrite historical administrative research.
Exact historical garrison locations and formation strengths are stored in content/history and source-status fields, not inferred from the physical map.
